deadline.value: All CMB application materials and fee waiver requests are due December 1.
deadline.quote: the deadline to submit a CMB application is December 1st.

gre_general.value: The Graduate College listing says no GRE is required for CMB.
gre_general.quote: Additional Requirements: No GRE required; TOEFL of 100 or higher is required for all international applicants

gre_subject.value: The Graduate College listing says no GRE is required for CMB.
gre_subject.quote: Additional Requirements: No GRE required; TOEFL of 100 or higher is required for all international applicants

toefl_min.value: The page gives an old-scale TOEFL iBT score, which predates the January 2026 change; the new-scale value is not confirmed.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee, and students complete three research rotations in the first year before choosing an advisor.
supervisor.quote: During the first year, CMB students engage in three research rotations with potential advisors to find the right research learning environment for dissertation work.

funding.value: The FAQ says faculty must commit funding for a new student, but no page says all admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: Our program asks current faculty for their ability to fully train a new student (this includes space and time in the lab, and funding for both research and stipend).

entry_route.value: Applicants need the equivalent of a US bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: All applicants must have the equivalent of a US bachelor’s degree, which consists of 16 years of formal education.

notes: Biomedical field is covered by the CMB PhD. Biochemistry and Microbiology PhDs are awarded through CMB; they are not separate records.
